content.outro: The gap bell carries down the pass, and the Gap House is shut for the night with the party inside it.
content.premise: The Gap House is a stone refuge hall at the top of Harrow Gap, and Bet Ashby keeps it. At dusk she bars the door and rings the gap bell, so anyone still on the road below knows the house is shut and the pass is not to be tried till morning. The party has come up the road with the last of the light.
content.theme: A refuge hall at the top of a pass, barred for the night, and the bell that tells the road below.
content.title: The Lever and the Keeper
